title: TBS P300 Stimulation and Recording Protocol
author: Nuno Pinto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kr3cv8n

steps.title: Perform Pre-TBS Auditory P300 Recording
steps.instruction: Record auditory P300 using an 8 channel Keypoint.net v.2.03 with active electrodes at Cz, Pz, P3, and P4 (10/20 international system) and an anterior reference.

substeps.instruction: Set device parameters: time constant of 1 second, high-frequency filter of 50 Hz, time base of 1000 ms, and automatic overload rejection mode on.
Implement auditory oddball paradigm: 80% frequent stimuli (1000 Hz, 50 ms duration) and 20% random target stimuli (2000 Hz, 100 ms duration) at a minimal intensity of 65 dB HL.
Deliver at least 400 stimuli, ensuring a minimum of 100 targets.
Identify peaks: N200 (largest negative peak between 160-260 ms) and P300 (largest positive peak after N1, P2, and N2, occurring between 220-600 ms).
Calculate amplitude as the maximum negativity and positivity components of the N2-P3 complex.

steps.title: Determine Active Motor Threshold (AMT)
steps.instruction: Use a 70 mm figure-8 coil with a MagVenture MagPro® G3 X100 5.0.1 to find the AMT.

substeps.instruction: Identify the minimal stimulation intensity over the motor cortex necessary to cause muscle contraction in more than five out of ten trials while the subject maintains a voluntary mild contraction.

steps.title: Administer TBS Stimulation
steps.instruction: Perform iTBS, cTBS, or sham stimulation over the right or left DLPFC, 5 cm rostral to the region of the most prominent motor response of the contralateral used muscle.

substeps.instruction: For iTBS/cTBS: Deliver bursts of 3 pulses at 50 Hz every 200 ms (5 Hz) at 80% AMT.
For cTBS: Deliver bursts without interruption for a total of 600 pulses.
For iTBS: Deliver 600 pulses total, with bursts at 5 Hz for 2 s (groups of 10 bursts), repeated every 10 seconds.
For Sham: Use the same coil tilted 90 degrees away from the scalp while maintaining contact and sound, with intensity reduced to 50% AMT.

steps.title: Perform Post-TBS Auditory P300 Recording
steps.instruction: Repeat the auditory P300 recording process using the same parameters as the pre-TBS recording.

substeps.instruction: Use 8 channel Keypoint.net v.2.03 with electrodes at Cz, Pz, P3, and P4 and anterior reference.
Maintain settings: 1s time constant, 50 Hz high-frequency filter, 1000 ms time base, and automatic overload rejection on.
Apply oddball paradigm: 80% frequent (1000 Hz, 50 ms) and 20% target (2000 Hz, 100 ms) stimuli at minimum 65 dB HL.
Identify N200 (160-260 ms) and P300 (220-600 ms) peaks and calculate N2-P3 complex amplitude.
